description: NASA'nın bu görevi için öğrencilerden oluşan ekip üyeleri..
summary:
We created a tool that makes NASA data regarding brown dwarfs, comets, and asteroids accessible to public. Our challenge requires us to make a tool for this reason. By making the data available through the software we do what is needed for our challenge. 

Our tool is very important for humanity as it would require knowledge in doctoral profession to find data on IRSA. We make it possible for everyone via our project.
details: Our tool can make it possible for people to reach NASA data faster by avoiding complex info found on IRSA. The system takes data from IRSA and transforms it into easily readable. After that, this website helps people learn more about the NASA data by just one click. One of the benefits is that even beginners who have limited knowledge about SphereX may even reach to these information. These people will be able to find out more about space by just checking our website instead of complex info on the NASA website. We used Visual Studio Code to develop our project and also we got assistance from AI for coding. It's creative because it becomes entertaining and easy for people to reach information regarding space observation and NASA data.
